name: hb_electronics CI/CD Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'gestion_stock/gestion_stock_ui/hb_electronics/**'
      - 'gestion_stock_ui/hb_electronics/**'
      - 'Docker/frontend/**'
      - 'docker-compose.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/*-frontend.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'gestion_stock/gestion_stock_ui/hb_electronics/**'
      - 'gestion_stock_ui/hb_electronics/**'
      - 'Docker/frontend/**'
      - 'docker-compose.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/*-frontend.yml'

env:
  ENABLE_DEPLOY: ${{ vars.ENABLE_DEPLOY || 'false' }}
  REGISTRY_HOST: ${{ secrets.REGISTRY_HOST }}
  REGISTRY_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.REGISTRY_USERNAME }}
  REGISTRY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.REGISTRY_PASSWORD }}
  IMAGE_TAG: ${{ secrets.REGISTRY_HOST }}/${{ secrets.REGISTRY_USERNAME }}/gestiondestock-ui:latest

jobs:
  test:
    name: Unit Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: gestion_stock/gestion_stock_ui/hb_electronics
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: gestion_stock/gestion_stock_ui/hb_electronics/package-lock.json
      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          npm ci
          npm test -- --watch=false

  build:
    name: Build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: gestion_stock/gestion_stock_ui/hb_electronics
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: gestion_stock/gestion_stock_ui/hb_electronics/package-lock.json
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Build application
        run: npm run build

  package:
    name: Package
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: gestion_stock/gestion_stock_ui/hb_electronics
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: gestion_stock/gestion_stock_ui/hb_electronics/package-lock.json
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Build
        run: npm run build
      - name: Pack package
        run: npm pack
      - name: Show generated artifacts
        run: ls -la

  upload_artifact:
    name: Upload Artifact
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: package
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: gestion_stock/gestion_stock_ui/hb_electronics
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: gestion_stock/gestion_stock_ui/hb_electronics/package-lock.json
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Build
        run: npm run build
      - name: Pack package
        run: npm pack
      - name: Upload artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: hb_electronics-artifacts
          path: |
            gestion_stock/gestion_stock_ui/hb_electronics/dist/**
            gestion_stock/gestion_stock_ui/hb_electronics/*.tgz
          retention-days: 30

  security_scan:
    name: Security Scan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: upload_artifact
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Check for Dockerfile
        id: dockerfile_check
        run: |
          if [ -f "gestion_stock/gestion_stock_ui/hb_electronics/Dockerfile" ]; then
            echo "exists=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "exists=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi
      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        if: steps.dockerfile_check.outputs.exists == 'true'
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3
      - name: Log in to registry
        if: steps.dockerfile_check.outputs.exists == 'true'
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY_HOST }}
          username: ${{ env.REGISTRY_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ env.REGISTRY_PASSWORD }}
      - name: Extract version for tagging
        if: steps.dockerfile_check.outputs.exists == 'true'
        id: version
        run: |
          cd gestion_stock/gestion_stock_ui/hb_electronics
          echo "VERSION=$(jq -r '.version' package.json)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
      - name: Build and push Docker image
        if: steps.dockerfile_check.outputs.exists == 'true'
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: gestion_stock/gestion_stock_ui/hb_electronics
          file: gestion_stock/gestion_stock_ui/hb_electronics/Dockerfile
          push: true
          platforms: linux/amd64
          tags: |
            ${{ env.IMAGE_TAG }}
            ${{ env.REGISTRY_HOST }}/${{ env.REGISTRY_USERNAME }}/gestiondestock-ui:${{ steps.version.outputs.VERSION }}
      - name: Run Trivy vulnerability scanner
        if: steps.dockerfile_check.outputs.exists == 'true'
        uses: aquasec/trivy-action@master
        with:
          image-ref: '${{ env.REGISTRY_HOST }}/${{ env.REGISTRY_USERNAME }}/gestiondestock-ui:${{ steps.version.outputs.VERSION }}'
          format: 'sarif'
          output: 'trivy-results.sarif'
          severity: 'HIGH,CRITICAL'
          exit-code: '1'
      - name: Upload Trivy scan results
        if: steps.dockerfile_check.outputs.exists == 'true'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: trivy-scan-results
          path: trivy-results.sarif
          retention-days: 30
      - name: No Dockerfile found
        if: steps.dockerfile_check.outputs.exists == 'false'
        run: echo "No Dockerfile found; skipping Docker build and security scan."

  deploy:
    name: Deploy
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: security_scan
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && env.ENABLE_DEPLOY == 'true'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up kubectl
        uses: azure/setup-kubectl@v4
        with:
          version: 'latest'
      - name: Configure kubectl
        run: |
          echo "${{ secrets.KUBE_CONFIG }}" | base64 -d > kubeconfig
          echo "::add-path::$(dirname $(which kubectl))"
      - name: Deploy to Kubernetes
        run: |
          kubectl set image deployment/gestiondestock-ui gestiondestock-ui=${{ env.IMAGE_TAG }} -n gestionstock
          kubectl rollout restart deployment/gestiondestock-ui -n gestionstock
        shell: bash
      - name: Helm deploy (optional)
        run: |
          echo "Example helm deploy: helm upgrade --install app ./chart --set image.repository=${{ env.REGISTRY_HOST }}/${{ env.REGISTRY_USERNAME }}/gestiondestock-ui --set image.tag=latest"
        shell: bash

  IMAGE_TAG: ${{ vars.IMAGE_TAG }}
  ENABLE_DEPLOY: ${{ vars.ENABLE_DEPLOY }}

jobs:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup JDK
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: "17"
          distribution: "corretto"

      - name: Set execute permissions for Maven Wrapper
        run: chmod +x gestion_stock/gestiondestock/mvnw

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: ./mvnw -B test
        working-directory: gestion_stock/gestiondestock

  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test

        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: "17"
          distribution: "corretto"

      - name: Set execute permissions for Maven Wrapper
        run: chmod +x gestion_stock/gestiondestock/mvnw

      - name: Build project (compile)
        run: ./mvnw -B -DskipTests clean compile
        working-directory: gestion_stock/gestiondestock

  package:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup JDK
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: "17"
          distribution: "corretto"

      - name: Set execute permissions for Maven Wrapper
        run: chmod +x gestion_stock/gestiondestock/mvnw

      - name: Package artifact
        run: ./mvnw -B -DskipTests package
        working-directory: gestion_stock/gestiondestock

      - name: Login to container registry
        if: fileExists('gestion_stock/gestiondestock/Dockerfile')
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY_HOST }}
          username: ${{ secrets.REGISTRY_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.REGISTRY_PASSWORD }}

      - name: Build and push Docker image
        if: fileExists('gestion_stock/gestiondestock/Dockerfile')
        run: |
          docker build -t ${{ env.REGISTRY_HOST }}/gestiondestock:${{ env.IMAGE_TAG }} gestion_stock/gestiondestock
          docker push ${{ env.REGISTRY_HOST }}/gestiondestock:${{ env.IMAGE_TAG }}

  upload_artifact:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: package
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Upload artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: gestiondestock-artifacts
          path: gestion_stock/gestiondestock/target/

  security_scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: package
    if: fileExists('gestion_stock/gestiondestock/Dockerfile')
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Install Trivy
        run: |
          curl -sfL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aquasecurity/trivy/main/contrib/install.sh | sudo sh -s -- -b /usr/local/bin

      - name: Run Trivy scan on Docker image
        run: |
          trivy image --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --exit-code 1 ${{ env.REGISTRY_HOST }}/gestiondestock:${{ env.IMAGE_TAG }}

  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [upload_artifact, security_scan]
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && env.ENABLE_DEPLOY == 'true'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
